newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grains volatile in thin stg led trade.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grains volatile in thin stg led trade.

text.p: UK physical grains were easier, in volatile sterling driven trade on Tuesday, with volume thin, traders said.
"The physical market's following the pound. It's not so active, but it is volatile," one trader said.
"There's a bit of marking time going on at the moment," another said.
But he noted that more was coming off farms. "People are finding a bit more than they thought there was," he said.
By late European trading sterling was down against the mark by around one pfennig in comparison with late Monday, although off session lows.
Delivered market milling wheat was traded in the Midlands at 112.00 stg for June delivery. In East Anglia feed wheat was traded at 88.50 stg for May and 91.00 stg and 90.00 stg for July.
